note: Against C1 no level changes. In words it lacks less. M6 and M1: for the top sixteen files of the first stage the question, the file's best chunk and its past messages are read as one sequence, through adapters on the same small encoder. M4: the encoder's cut-off comes before the validation stretch and every example is marked by it. M3: each relation's sum is divided by one constant per repository before the logarithm; counts survive because the constant is per repository, not per node. Time: the lag curve counted per repository enters as columns for every file. One score now ranks every file. M7: the joint pass adds about an hour per epoch by the design's own argument, the fit is still argued and the same kind of counts stay open; judged not lower, which is the reader's call. Still lacking: outside the top sixteen content is read through frozen vectors; sizes and ages written into the joint sequence are read badly (N 13.9) and only the exact columns carry them; the encoder stays in the class of 0.1 to 0.3 billion parameters. Every veto read again, none met. It replaces C1.

Against C3 no level changes. In words it lacks less. M1 and M2: the exact bank is also summed apart by what was done to the candidate in each joint event and by bulk and bot flags, for every file; in the shortlist the reader's head reads a bounded question gate over the pair's joint events, neutral at zero, with the ungated bank kept. M1 for the three questions: penalised parts per kind of question in the reader's head and shallow trees per kind over the shared trees, zero where a kind has too few validation questions. M4: every pretrained cut-off before the validation stretch, examples marked. M7: the reader's size now follows from the compute and the count of questions (about 0.35 billion parameters at 50,000 questions, 1.8 billion at 10,000). The trees per kind are an added piece; they bring back what the dropped A8.a.2 proposed. M7 otherwise: about 150 more columns and 13 % fewer rows per card; judged not lower, the reader's call. Not answered, reasons accepted: typed counts over three links (5,184 types) and a folder route into the shortlist would both lower M7. Every veto read again, none met. It replaces C3.
